name: code-review-benchmark
description: A dataset intended to evaluate models on tasks related to code review: understanding diffs, predicting reviewer comments or labels, and possibly generating review suggestions. It can be used to benchmark both classification (e.g., accept/reject, defect labels) and natural-language/code generation for review comments. Evaluation typically combines automatic classification metrics and human judgement for generated review text.
evaluation_method: F1/accuracy for classification tasks; human_eval and BLEU/ROUGE or pass@k for generated review text
general_score_metric: F1 (for labeled classification tasks); human_eval or pass@k for generation
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage for code-review research and tooling experiments.
